present_on_scene_date.note: Heald's official report and Journal name the four officers in the action. No source takes a roll call on the afternoon of 14 August 1812; this is read from the evidence below.

persons.note: Currey: graduated West Point only the year before. Wau-Bun portrays him as at odds with Heald; Mrs. Heald (via Darius, Kirkland Part I) denied it. After 14 August: Killed in battle near the baggage wagons, fighting on one knee (Wau-Bun).
